answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the signal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The opal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the garden. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit.
